issues.message: Only 42 blocks: too bare for a common (at least 50). Carlton wants more detail, not less.

notes.detail: Shell only: footing stairs, corbels and crenels; acceptable for an L1 wall module.
notes.roof: Crenellated parapet on corbels with a 2-wide walk that turns the corner.
notes.shape: Tiny 3x3 module; the corner pier is only the flush corner column one block higher with a stair cap, so it hardly reads as a pier.
notes.scale: Wall module: block count warning ignored per standing rules.

visual.summary: Outside corner module of the stone wall: battered footing, corbelled crenellated parapet and a walk that turns the corner, with a corner column topped by a stair at (0,7,0).
problems: Open ends match the straight profile (footing stair y0, wall z1-2/x1-2, corbel stair y4, parapet y5, walk standing at y5, merlons at even positions), so it joins cleanly. Note for the whole wall set, not this piece: odd-length modules with merlons at both ends put two merlons side by side at every joint (corner x2 next to straight x0, same as straight x4 next to straight x0).

Optional: the corner 'pier' at x0 z0 is flush with both parapets; make it stick out or rise properly (e.g. a 2-high cap instead of the single south-facing stair at (0,7,0), which looks like a stray step from the east).
